Cause: `cargo build --release -p grit-cli -p grit-utils` fails in grit-lib/src/porcelain/stash.rs with E0425 (`stored` not found in scope, ~lines 2344 and 2605) and E0308 (`entry.path` is Vec<u8> where `worktree_abs` expects &str / String, ~lines 2313 and 2321), apparently a bad merge of the non-UTF-8 stash path work (#2512/#2513) with the repo_relpath change. The same errors fail CI clippy and rustdoc on main: run 41533491898 (push of release: v0.5.29, 2026-11-02T22:00Z); the scheduled CI run on main at 2026-11-03T04:20Z (41577589820) also failed. origin/main was re-fetched on 2026-11-04 and was still 8cb4162ac. Per the maintainer's decision: no bisecting, no local patch, nothing landed on main; re-run once main is fixed. grit.commit is the full sha of main as it is; grit.version is "0.5.29 (did not build)".
How the git side was measured: grit-bench cannot be built from main (it links grit-lib), so the harness was built in a scratch clone (/tmp/harness) at 826644807 (the commit the 2026-11-01 report measured); grit-utils/src/daily and grit-utils/src/main.rs are byte-identical between 826644807 and main 8cb4162ac, so the scenario definitions, fixtures, prepare steps and sample policy (3 warmups, adaptive 5-20 timed runs, ABAB) are exactly main's. The harness pairs the tools, so each scenario ran one `grit-bench daily --only <id>` invocation with that 0.5.28 grit as the paired tool; ALL grit numbers, grit phases and grit RSS were discarded, and only git's median/stddev/min/max/samples/runs/peak RSS and git's trace phases are published. Because the paired grit was a different (older) build, treat the git samples as ABAB-interleaved with some other tool, as in every earlier report. detail.commands.grit and detail.correctness describe what the harness ran and are carried unchanged; detail.phases.grit is empty.

The four HTTP scenarios used git http-backend / grit-http-server from the 826644807 build on PATH. Noise check: the grit/git regression check cannot apply with no grit numbers; instead the git medians were compared to the 2026-11-01 report and all 172 are within -21%/+12% (no re-runs needed, none were done).
